quest_lastdenn_ring.title: A ring to rob them all
quest_lastdenn_ring.summary: Lambertus was robbed by orcs very near the waterfall and bridge of Lastdenn. He said that the orcs took a very valuable golden ring from him. He wants you to get it back for him.

1.taskPhrase: Get the golden ring from the orcs to the south of the bridge.

2.taskPhrase: Return the golden ring back to Lambertus at the Lastdenn Inn.

quest_lastdenn_ryiah.title: Prison break
quest_lastdenn_ryiah.summary: Ryiah is a witch who got arrested for suspicion of being a witch. Which she is. She is currently being held in Lastdenn jail, and she needs your help to get out.

1.taskPhrase: Retrieve the jail key from the off duty guard in the bar.

2.taskPhrase: Open the jail door with the jail key and break Ryiah out of jail.

3.comment: WARNING: 1 link to 3 in ryiah's lastdenn sparkle quest checker
3.taskPhrase: Find Ryiah's belongings in a crate in front of Lastdenn's Equipment Shop.

quest_lastdenn_reignald.title: Commander Conquer
quest_lastdenn_reignald.summary: Commander Reignald leads the Lastdenn guard with absolute discipline and loyalty to the city. Though he secretly longs to leave, his sense of duty keeps him in place. Who can convince him that serving Lastdenn might mean fighting beyond its walls?

1.taskPhrase: Ask Reignald to join your party after he had a conversation with Father Santino.

quest_lastdenn_santino.title: Meet the priest
quest_lastdenn_santino.summary: It seems that the priest of Lastdenn is Father Santino. As he is the priest of the Temple of Evdos, the God of Knowledge, he should know a thing or two about Ulrog, the God of Power. That is the reason why Ylarus, the God of Time, sent you to him, right? Information is key here.

1.taskPhrase: Meet with Father Santino at 11:00 and ask him about Ulrog.

2.taskPhrase: Meet with Father Santino at 18:00 to let him prepare the information you need about Ulrog.

quest_lastdenn_garrin.title: Garrin's ghost
quest_lastdenn_garrin.summary: Garrin was possessed by a ghost, and the ghost of Garrin has murdered Father Santino at 13:00 in the streets of Lastdenn. Two passing guards arrested Garrin, while the ghost already left his body.

1.comment: WARNING: One link to 1 in SceneGhostPossessesGarrin.exitScreen()
1.taskPhrase: [Optional] Find out what has happened with Garrin.
1.updatedPhrase: [Optional] Witness the possession of Garrin by the ghost around 09:00.

2.taskPhrase: Prevent the murder of Father Santino.

3.comment: WARNING: 4 links in garrin_early_morning and 2 links in garrin_in_jail and 1 link in santino_counseling.
3.taskPhrase: Find out about the proof hidden away in Garrin's drawer.

4.taskPhrase: Get the key from Garrin for his wife's drawer.

5.taskPhrase: Open the drawer in Garrin's house and take the proof.

6.taskPhrase: Show Father Santino the proof and claim his holy staff.

7.taskPhrase: Destroy the ghost before it possesses Garrin.

8.taskPhrase: Report back to Father Santino about the ghost you destroyed.
